description: Starts (or resumes) a claim on a custom domain and returns the DNS TXT record that proves it is the user's: they add it at the domain's DNS provider, then you call verify_domain. Until it verifies, list_domains shows the domain as pending. A pending claim's TXT value can change (values are specific to each account), so add exactly the value get_domain_verification returns now, never one saved earlier or seen on another account; if verify_domain keeps failing, call get_domain_verification again and update the record when the value differs. A name under redu.cloud needs no verification.

domain.description: The custom domain to verify ownership of (e.g. app.example.com).

name: get_domain_verification
title: Get domain verification TXT record
